title: All 15 scenarios passed — hands-free audio and task interruption infrastructure added
summary: This PR adds robot-local hands-free voice interaction (wake-word detection, reverse audio bridge, Liaison orchestration) and reliable task interruption via Executor cancel-all. All 15 CI scenarios passed across builtin, cap, and flow families, exercising 20 capabilities including speech, navigation, exploration, memory, and scene perception. No regressions were observed; the new hands-free and wake-word contracts were not directly tested by existing scenarios but are covered by build-time import validation.
pr_changes: Added 4 new service definitions: GetAudioBridgeInfo, GetHandsfreeStatus, SetHandsfree, WatchHandsfreeEvents
Added 5 new capability TOML manifests: bridge_info, wake_word, handsfree events/set_enabled/status
Modified liaison/submit and liaison/voice contracts from kind=system to kind=service
Rewrote audio_client_bridge to support reverse WebSocket transport (robot listens, client connects)
Added ReverseAudioBridge class with mic/speaker streaming, barge-in, and control request handling
Added bridge_info gRPC endpoint to audio_client_bridge for Atlas discovery
Added wake_word.py with sherpa-onnx KWS backend and keyword file preparation
Added SpeechWakeWordServicer and wake-word initialization in speech service init
Added TTS caching and prewarm support in SpeechTtsServicer
Made local inference dependencies optional (local extra) in speech pyproject.toml
Added build-time model download for sherpa-onnx KWS model and Tencent backend validation
Added HandsfreeController in liaison with wake-word loop, voice turn orchestration, and event broadcasting
Added hands-free gRPC servicers (set_enabled, status, events) to liaison main
Modified voice session to suspend/resume hands-free capture and support barge-in metadata
Added VoiceSessionStream wrapper that aborts session task on drop
Added no-speech timeout (5s) and final_text TTS boundary handling in voice.rs
Added cancel_all_executor_plans call in Pilot abort_turn handler for reliable task interruption
Added exclusive mic stream lock in audio_driver to prevent overlapping capture
Added deployment-configured device IDs to audio_driver device list for persistence
Added guard_terminal_xy_m: 0.20 to nav2 config to prevent path-alignment yaw correction from being mistaken for stuck final rotation
Added voiceprint_service kill pattern to sim/stop.sh
Updated speech README with wake-word configuration and Tencent backend setup instructions
Updated speech package_manifest PYTHONPATH to include MCP types
Updated speech build.sh to support SPEECH_BACKEND=mock, Jetson torch, and wake-word model download
test_result: All 15 scenarios passed (15/15, 100%). Builtin tests: fault_recovery_builtin (3 rounds), file_roundtrip, plan_control_builtins, run_command. Cap tests: camera_snapshot, explore_smoke (2 rounds), lidar_snapshot, mapping_save, memory_roundtrip, scene_object_fixture, speech_speak, voiceprint_list. Flow tests: fault_recovery (4 rounds), object_navigation (4 rounds), patrol_observe (3 rounds). Coverage includes 20 capabilities across executor, camera, lidar, mapping, memory, navigation, scene, speech, voiceprint, and explore.
suggested_fix: No fix needed. Monitor scene-graph LLM enrichment failures (fake-vlm returns empty JSON) — these are expected with the mock VLM and do not affect scenario pass/fail. The new hands-free and wake-word capabilities are not yet exercised by CI scenarios; consider adding a wake-word detection smoke test in a follow-up.
risks_or_watchouts: Scene-graph LLM enrichment repeatedly fails with JSONDecodeError from fake-vlm — expected with mock, but real deployments need a working VLM endpoint.
New hands-free and wake-word contracts are not covered by existing CI scenarios; a dedicated smoke test would be valuable.
Audio driver mic stream lock may cause RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED errors if two clients attempt simultaneous capture — verify behavior in multi-client deployments.
Reverse audio bridge has no authentication or TLS — suitable only for trusted LAN or tunneled connections.
